about: A slow reply that reasons first, for watching streaming, the thinking display and stopping a reply part way.

rules.think: Thinking it over slowly, one piece at a time, so that the reasoning can be watched as it arrives.
rules.reply: This reply arrives slowly, a few characters at a time, so that the streaming can be watched and a reply can be stopped before it has finished. It goes on for a while yet, sentence after sentence, until it is done.
